svg.title: Entry: the response must remain optimal after entry
svg.desc: Synthetic perfect-information entry tree. The bold route uses the no-contract subgame-perfect continuation. The public contract is a separate preceding choice, summarized below.

g.text: Entry: the response must remain optimal after entry
Payoffs: entrant first, incumbent second. Bold path = no-contract SPNE.
Normal-form pure NE: (O,F), (I,A); only (I,A) is subgame perfect.
Prior enforceable contract: bond 3, fee 1/2; initial pure-SPNE choice(s): Post.
Refunded bond is not a permanent cost. Enforcement and affordability are model assumptions.
